description:
Here are a few small actions you can take to break the malaise and start a bit of momentum:

- have a shower
- have a healthy snack
- research the info you need for a task
- call a loved one
- do a simple chore
- listen to some music and dance
transcript: Did you know you can stop feeling shit for not getting enough done today and it'll only take 60 seconds? Four fast questions, one easy action. That's how you break the end-of-day shame loop. I don't know what that was, I'm sorry. But if you can get past the second question, the rest is easy. Question one, the scary one. What are you avoiding right now? Question two, what feels bad about it? Question three, what do you do when you accidentally touch something hot? Question four, does your nervous system deserve to be criticized for doing doing its job? Which leads us to the one easy action. Avoiding a hot pot is normal. Flinching away is normal. You don't yell at yourself, you grab oven mitts. One small easy action that makes you feel slightly better. So you don't need to flinch and numb. Not fucking big shit. I don't care about your productivity. I care about interrupting the shame loop so it doesn't spiral into tomorrow. Some ideas for the small easy oven mitt actions in the caption. I'm just going that way if you want to come. Sorry. Excuse me. Thank you.
